Package dev.turboism.sdk.permission

Class PermissionIds

java.lang.Object
dev.turboism.sdk.permission.PermissionIds
public final class PermissionIds extends Object
Canonical identifiers for permission-protected Turboism operation families.

Declare only the permissions required by a plugin's user-facing behavior. Authorization is independent of host/version provider availability and does not bypass lifecycle, validation, ownership, stale-reference, or capability gates.
